text:
maria (Finance): saw an invoice from CloudForge stuck in approvals queue, missing PO. Can procurement confirm if a PO exists?

sam (Procurement): checking... I don't see a PO in Coupa with that vendor and amount. Do we have a vendor contract for them?

maria (Finance): Vendor onboarding was completed last quarter, yes. Invoice details pasted below:
```
Invoice: INV-2025-1145
Vendor: CloudForge Inc.
Amount: $12,350.00
Date: 2025-09-18
PO: — NOT ATTACHED
```

lina (AP): approvals-bot flagged this as "awaiting PO" and auto-hold kicked in. ap-bot says: invoice INV-2025-1145 status: HOLD (missing PO). link: https://app.redwood/approvals/INV-2025-1145

ap-bot: AUTO-HOLD: Invoice INV-2025-1145 placed on hold at 12:34 UTC. Reason: PO not matched. Next action: attach PO or escalate to procurement.

sam (Procurement): I searched vendor/master list. There's a PO request draft from Aug 30 that was never approved: PR-7782 -> intended PO would be PO-55431 but it didn't get to legal. I'll pull the docs.

chris (Legal): I saw PR-7782 yesterday; legal flagged missing SOW clause for data residency. We asked vendor for updated SOW. Did CloudForge send it?

maria (Finance): cloudforge billing said they included SOW in the submission but AP couldn't find it. Sam, can you confirm whether vendor uploaded corrected SOW? We need to avoid paying until PO is in place.

sam (Procurement): pinged the vendor (cloudforge-billing@cloudforge.com) asking for revised SOW and to reissue invoice referencing PO-55431. Sent at 12:55 UTC. 

lina (AP): If vendor reissues invoice with PO-55431 we can route approval to @sam and @maria and release payment on the next cycle. For now will keep hold.

maria (Finance): tagging @chris (Legal) — if vendor sends SOW, can legal fast-track review so we don't block September close?

chris (Legal): yes, can do expedited review if doc is exact; ask vendor to call out the residency clause in the email subject. I'll prioritize.

maria (Finance): thanks. I'll update accounting ticket ACCT-4392 and mark as "awaiting vendor SOW/PO" :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

lina (AP): quick note — GL code on the invoice was "4300-Cloud Services" which matches the PO once created. No mismatch there.

sam (Procurement): vendor replied: will reissue with PO and attached SOW by EOD. I'll drop the new doc into PR-7782 thread when it arrives. :thumbsup:

maria (Finance): sounds good. @ap-bot — please send a follow-up notification if invoice still on hold in 48h.

ap-bot: FOLLOW-UP scheduled: will notify finance in 48 hours if status unchanged.

maria (Finance): closing loop here for now. I'll update when payment is cleared or vendor reissues.

lina (AP): thanks all :white_check_mark:
